title: Gap Inc. to Report Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results on November 19

# Gap Inc. to Report Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results on November 19


by Gap Inc.


[Gap Inc.](https://www.gapinc.com/en-us/news/gap-inc)


October 29, 2026


[Gap Inc.](https://www.gapinc.com/en-us/) (NYSE: GAP) will report its third quarter fiscal 2026 financial results by press release on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at approximately 1:15 p.m. Pacific Time.


In addition, the company will host a conference call to review its third quarter fiscal 2026 results on Thursday, November 19, 2026, beginning at approximately 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time.


A live webcast of the conference call will be available online at[investors.gapinc.com](https://investors.gapinc.com/) . A replay of the webcast will be available at the same location.


**About Gap Inc.**
Gap Inc., a purpose-driven house of iconic brands, is the largest specialty apparel company in America. Its[Old Navy](https://oldnavy.gap.com/) ,[Gap](https://www.gap.com/) ,[Banana Republic](https://bananarepublic.gap.com/) , and[Athleta](https://athleta.gap.com/) brands offer clothing, accessories, and lifestyle products for men, women and children available worldwide through company-operated and franchise stores, and e-commerce sites. Through[Encore](https://www.gap.com/customer-service/encore-membership?cid=3053357&msockid=2f6d747bd7726cd32307637fd6486d33) , its cross-brand membership program, Gap Inc. has created products and experiences that shape culture, while doing right by employees, communities and the planet through its commitment to bridge gaps to create a better world. For more information, please visit[www.gapinc.com](https://www.gapinc.com/) .
